headline: Russian Foreign Minister Likely to Discuss Nuclear Arms With Trump and Pompeo
text: Russian Foreign Minister Likely to Discuss Nuclear Arms With Trump and Pompeo Sergey V. Lavrov is set to visit the White House on Tuesday afternoon, for a conversation that could include extending the last major nuclear treaty between the United States and Russia. The White House has said nothing official about a meeting the Kremlin has announced, but any talks with Sergey V. Lavrov could include extending the last major nuclear treaty between the countries.
